messages.subject: A Tutorial Source
parts:
Hello,

First of all thanks for this great package. I would like to begin to learn it as soon as possible. However it seems the wiki page in GitHub is no longer accessible and I am unable to find a recent version of "Quick Guide to Geomorph". Can anyone point me to a source?

Thank you,

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] A Tutorial Source
parts:
The wiki page and guide to geomorph have been removed, because they were
difficult to keep updated and the authors felt they were not adding to
providing proper training to the users.

The package´s documentation brochure and help files are quite complete
(or so we hope!) and they should be sufficient to guide you for
implementing GM methods in R. Also, many questions are frequently
answered through this forum, so if in doubt please search the group´s
history. It is very probable that your doubt has been already addressed
by other users. If this is not the case, feel free to use the forum for
specific questions on geomorph: the authors of the package and other
users will do their best to help you.

For a more full training, keep also an open eye for future courses on
using geomorph to implement GM in R.

Antigoni
